messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High latency detected on gen-eu service (eu-central). Pager triggered for oncall jordan. Incident ID INC-2025-847. Link: https://pager.example/INC-2025-847
jordan: Oncall here — looking. Assigning to sarah to triage.
sarah: Investigating. I see gen-queue-02 backlog growing and a memory spike on model-host-3.

sarah: logs (tail):
```
[14:03:12] model-host-3 oom-killer: out of memory
[14:03:12] gen-daemon: worker-7 crashed
[14:04:01] enqueue delay: 1200ms
```

elena: Drafting initial statuspage copy:
```
We are investigating increased latency and request queues for text generation in EU (eu-central). Some requests may experience delays or timeouts. Our engineers are actively investigating. No data loss has been reported.
```

elena: @alex for product copy, @kevin for legal — quick check? :eyes: 

alex: LGTM. Add ETA for mitigation attempt: "Expected mitigation steps to complete within ~30m" and call out "no data loss".
kevin: Legal OK with wording. Keep 'under investigation' until root cause confirmed.

jordan: Update from oncall: scaled gen-workers and restarted model-host-3. Latency trending down but still above baseline. Propose status update: "Mitigation in progress; partial restoration".
elena: I'll stage the initial + update cadence (every 10m). Who publishes to status page when you give the go, @jordan?

sarah: Metrics: p95 latency from 3.2s -> 0.9s after restart, error rate steady at 0.5%. Recommend monitoring 10m intervals.

incident-bot: Statuspage draft saved: https://status.redwood.ai/drafts/INC-2025-847-draft

alex: Approved. Publish initial now once @jordan confirms 'mitigation in progress' copy.

jordan: Confirmed — mitigation in progress copy OK. Publishing initial and will post update in 10m.
elena: Published initial notice. Status ID INC-2025-847. Customer notification queued to support@redwood.com and enterprise contacts. :white_check_mark: 

kevin: Confirmed enterprise contacts notified. No legal flags.

sarah: Root cause identified — memory leak in the model loader config. Hotfix deployed to model-host-3, monitoring for stability.
jordan: Plan: if metrics stable for 60m publish resolved notice and close pager. I'll keep the pager open until then.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-847: Mitigation applied; monitoring. Resolved notice scheduled if stable at +60m.

elena: I'll prepare the resolved copy:
```
Resolved: The elevated latency and queues impacting EU text generation were caused by a memory leak in the model loader. A hotfix was deployed and service returned to normal. No customer data was affected. If you continue to see issues, contact support.
```

jordan: Thanks team — good job. Keep watches for 60m, then publish resolved.
